reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because its primary purpose is to explain blockchain through ledger and network concepts. It discusses cryptocurrency alongside technical and organizational applications such as healthcare, real estate, media, agriculture, and supply chains, without a concrete promise of returns or required payment flow. Coinbase-related links and an ordinary subscription request are described as informational details rather than deceptive financial solicitation.

citations.quote: A blockchain is a digital list of transactions that anyone can view and verify.
large network of computers all over the world, which we call a peer-to-peer network.
Blockchains are also being used to record, track and verify information in healthcare, real estate, media, agriculture, supply chains, and so much more.
Another way to think about a blockchain is as a ledger
Blockchains enable secure payments to be made between people who don't know each other without having to go through a central verifier like a bank!

opening.argument: The presentation links cryptocurrency education to a concrete participation path. After presenting cryptocurrencies as powered by blockchain and emphasizing their practical payment use, the description tells viewers, "To own a piece of the future visit Coinbase." That is more than a neutral definition: it connects the attractive future-facing framing to visiting a branded crypto platform. The viewer is not merely asked to understand blockchain; the stated next step is to go to Coinbase in order to own part of that future. The content therefore functions as a solicitation for crypto participation, even though it avoids specifying a token, price, or guaranteed return. The absence of a precise return promise does not eliminate the promotional acquisition pathway.

citations.quote: To own a piece of the future visit Coinbase
Almost all cryptocurrencies, including bitcoin, ethereum, and light coin, are powered by blockchain technology.
Blockchains enable secure payments to be made between people who don't know each other

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense calls the Coinbase link informational, but the description does not merely provide background resources: it expressly pairs visiting Coinbase with owning "a piece of the future." The technical explanation supplies credibility for that invitation, while the branded destination supplies the participation route. Calling the surrounding material educational does not negate the action-oriented crypto promotion.

citations.quote: To own a piece of the future visit Coinbase
At Coinbase, our mission is to create an open financial system for the world.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The quoted phrase does not identify a token, purchase, appreciation claim, dividend, or holding return. "Own a piece of the future" is promotional language at most, and the supplied material expressly describes the content as informational and says it is not investment advice. The blockchain discussion explains technology and applications; it does not establish that viewers are directed to buy an asset.

does not constitute a recommendation by Coinbase to buy, sell or hold any security, financial product or instrument referenced in the content.

opening.argument: Several signals combine into a crypto-acquisition pitch: the video centers on cryptocurrencies, presents blockchain as enabling secure payments without a bank, uses Coinbase branding, and directs viewers to Coinbase with the language "own a piece of the future." The description also supplies a direct Coinbase URL and a subscription call. None of these details alone proves a scam, but together they create a low-friction promotional funnel around a financial technology whose benefits are presented in highly favorable terms. The technical vocabulary and institutional branding can make the invitation appear safer and more authoritative than an ordinary sales message. A careful judge should treat the risk-bearing promotional context as stronger than the video's classroom-like presentation.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense isolates the absence of a stated return and treats the links as ordinary details. But the relevant concern is the combination: crypto, favorable security and payment framing, recognizable Coinbase branding, and an invitation to own part of the future. The disclaimer does not erase the persuasive effect of those signals or the fact that viewers are directed to an external financial platform.

citations.quote: There are powerful security advantages because we can verify any transaction that has happened on that blockchain.
To own a piece of the future visit Coinbase

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The signals described are not scam-specific. Cryptocurrency terminology is inherent to a video explaining blockchain, and the cited "secure payments" statement explains a mechanism rather than promising profit. The Coinbase link is accompanied by an explicit disclaimer that the content is not investment advice, while no return, urgency, testimonial, deposit, or purchase instruction appears in the evidence.

does not constitute a recommendation by Coinbase to buy, sell or hold any security, financial product or instrument referenced in the content.

opening.argument: Although the video adopts an introductory lesson format, its role can be understood as branded promotion. It opens under Coinbase Crypto University branding, explains cryptocurrency and blockchain in accessible terms, highlights attractive cross-industry uses, states Coinbase's mission to create an open financial system, and ends with several Coinbase-directed calls to action. That structure builds trust and enthusiasm before steering viewers toward Coinbase. The educational wrapper therefore serves a promotional function: it normalizes crypto participation and presents the sponsor as the natural destination for viewers who want to act. The absence of an explicit sales pitch makes the steering subtler, not necessarily absent.

citations.quote: What is a Blockchain - Coinbase Crypto University
At Coinbase, our mission is to create an open financial system for the world.
To own a piece of the future visit Coinbase
Blockchains are also being used to record, track and verify information in healthcare, real estate, media, agriculture, supply chains, and so much more.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense focuses on the lesson's subject matter, but promotional content can use accurate instruction as its vehicle. Here, the branded educational setting, broad claims of usefulness, mission statement, and invitation to visit Coinbase work together to position one company as the gateway to the future described. The many applications make the product category appear broadly validated while the destination remains Coinbase.

citations.quote: Coinbase Crypto University
At Coinbase, our mission is to create an open financial system for the world.
To own a piece of the future visit Coinbase

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Brand presence and a channel subscription do not transform an explanatory video into a token-purchase scam. The cited applications are presented as examples of blockchain use, not as investment opportunities, and the supplied description expressly limits the content to information. Most importantly, the evidence does not show a token offer, appreciation claim, payment requirement, or promised financial outcome.
